challenge_facts_addressed.effect_on_judgment: The slower, shorter replies and absence of follow-up questions meaningfully support B, although they are also compatible with the unusually low bandwidth reported in C3-F3.
Two cancellations without concrete replacement times strengthen B, but Sam's suggestion of reconnecting after the deadline provides some time-bounded indication of continued interest.

Selective participation and posting while Riley waited for replies qualify the stress explanation, but brief group attendance and online activity do not establish that Sam had comparable capacity for one-on-one engagement.

reason_for_retaining_or_changing: A remains better supported because the communication change followed disclosed work and family stressors, Sam's reduced participation extended beyond Riley, and Sam proactively described low bandwidth and suggested reconnecting after the deadline. C3-F4 through C3-F6 create substantial uncertainty and reduce confidence, but do not outweigh C3-F1 through C3-F3.

revised_recommended_action.explanation: Allow the stated low-bandwidth period to pass, then assess whether Sam follows through on reconnecting; if the pattern continues afterward, clarify directly.
